376:class JobRun:
377-    """Mutable runtime record for one task within one scheduler execution.
378-
379-    A ``JobRun`` starts in ``PENDING`` and is advanced through the lifecycle by
380-    the state machine as the scheduler drives it. It records how many attempts
381-    have been made and a compact timeline of ``(virtual_time, state)`` entries
382-    so that history queries can reconstruct what happened without replaying the
383-    whole event log.
384-    """
385-
386-    __slots__ = (
387-        "task",
388-        "state",
389-        "attempts",
390-        "timeline",
391-        "admitted_at",
392-        "finish_at",
393-        "available_at",
394-        "last_error",
395-    )
396-
397-    def __init__(self, task):
398-        self.task = task
399-        self.state = State.PENDING
400-        self.attempts = 0
401-        self.timeline = [(0, State.PENDING)]
402-        # Virtual times, filled in by the scheduler.
403-        self.admitted_at = None
404-        self.finish_at = None
405-        self.available_at = 0
406-        self.last_error = None
407-
408-    @property
409-    def id(self):
410-        """The identifier of the underlying task."""
411-
412-        return self.task.id
413-
414-    @property
415-    def priority(self):
416-        """The scheduling priority of the underlying task."""
417-
418-        return self.task.priority
419-
420-    def record_state(self, state, now):
421-        """Set ``state`` and append a timeline entry stamped at ``now``.
422-
423-        The state machine calls this after it has validated a transition, so
424-        this method performs no validation itself -- it is a pure recorder.
425-        """
426-
427-        self.state = state
428-        self.timeline.append((now, state))
429-
430-    def note_attempt(self):
431-        """Increment and return the attempt counter (1-based after first call)."""
432-
433-        self.attempts += 1
434-        return self.attempts
435-
436-    def states_seen(self):
437-        """Return the ordered list of distinct-in-sequence states visited."""
438-
439-        return [state for _at, state in self.timeline]
440-
441-    def entered_state_at(self, state):
442-        """Return the virtual time the run first entered ``state``, or ``None``."""
443-
444-        for at, seen in self.timeline:
445-            if seen is state:
446-                return at
447-        return None
448-
449-    def was_retried(self):
450-        """Return ``True`` if the run ever passed through ``RETRYING``."""
451-
452-        return any(state is State.RETRYING for _at, state in self.timeline)
453-
454-    def is_settled(self):
455-        """Return ``True`` if the run has reached a terminal state."""
456-
457-        return self.state.is_terminal()
458-
459-    def succeeded(self):
460-        """Return ``True`` if the run finished in ``SUCCEEDED``."""
461-
462-        return self.state is State.SUCCEEDED
463-
464-    def __repr__(self):
465-        return "JobRun(id={!r}, state={}, attempts={})".format(
466-            self.id, self.state, self.attempts
